title: Snoring (Meme)
blurb: The meme snore — a deep, committed, theatrical snore that communicates one thing: this is boring beyond human endurance. Play it during long stories, meetings that could've been emails, and anyone explaining their fantasy football league. It's the polite society version of leaving. The snorer is asleep; the message is wide awake.
origin: The theatrical bored-snore of meme culture.
